.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias mirror: reference diode m=10 (1uA per unit), mirrors matched L=1
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1 m=10
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1 m=6
MS  o2    ibias vss vss nfet W=1 L=1 m=5
* preamp: NMOS pair (weak inversion, small), short-L PMOS mirror load -> low cap
M1  d1 vinp tail vss nfet W=2 L=0.15
M2  o1 vinn tail vss nfet W=2 L=0.15
M3  d1 d1 vdd vdd pfet W=0.6 L=0.15
M4  o1 d1 vdd vdd pfet W=0.6 L=0.15
* PMOS common-source gain stage, 1.67x M4 -> ~5uA at balance (matches MS)
M5  o2 o1 vdd vdd pfet W=0.5 L=0.15 m=2
* tapered inverter buffer (3 stages, overall inverting)
MN6 o3 o2 vss vss nfet W=0.42 L=0.15
MP6 o3 o2 vdd vdd pfet W=0.84 L=0.15
MN7 o4 o3 vss vss nfet W=1 L=0.15
MP7 o4 o3 vdd vdd pfet W=2.5 L=0.15
